يمتر (form VIII)
# يَمْتَرِ (yamtari) /jam.ta.ri/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِمْتَرَى (imtarā)
# يُمْتَرَ (yumtara) /jum.ta.ra/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive jussive of اِمْتَرَى (imtarā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
